title: Ride-Along recipient list
description: Cached recipient list. Refresh monthly, not per send. A human eyeballs it before the first send and after every refresh — the reference implementation's list contained the wrong contact at the right company, and that week's lead story was the other person's incident.

generated.description: Date this list was last refreshed from source systems.

source.description: How the list was derived — the query, in words. Future-you will want this.

status.description: Gate. A freshly generated list is never sendable until a human approves it.

exclusions.description: Brands, business lines, or company types that must never receive this edition. Encode exclusions as data so they survive a change of operator.

prospects.description: WARM ONLY — people met, quoted, or in an open opportunity. Cold lists belong in a different machine: personal sends from a human mailbox to a cold list is a deliverability and CAN-SPAM problem.

company_id.description: ID in your CRM/PSA, so the row can be re-derived.

first_name.description: Used for the personalized greeting. Derive it once, here — not at send time.

basis.description: Why this person is on the list — e.g. 'decision-maker', 'hand-added <date>', 'met at <event> <date>', 'open opportunity #NNNN'. Every row must justify itself. Rows that can't are how a warm list quietly becomes a cold one.

unsubscribed.description: Never delete an unsubscribe — mark it, so a list refresh can't resurrect it.
